CustomField.label: Search Keywords
CustomField.description: Comma-separated synonyms, error codes, product names, and symptom phrasings used to lift the correct article in SOSL knowledge search. Indexed by FIND...IN ALL FIELDS; not shown to end users.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Enter alternate terms, error codes, and symptom phrasings a user might type when searching for this article (e.g. "error -15, won't activate, license server unreachable"). Used only to improve search relevance.
